notes.title: Dead Age 2 polish language, Dead Age: Survivors Small News Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36253678/604c6056633bad0f90f12a9158b12a4e39346436.png

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16438/Dead_Age_12_Bundle/ 

Greetings survivors!
It's February and we have a Dead Age 2 update for the Polish language + some small news for the upcoming Dead Age: Survivors. 

Witajcie polscy gracze!

Finally we have the polish translation for Dead Age 2, thanks to Steamplayers bax001 (translator) and Matiko13 (tester).  Many thanks for this voluntary work! So Polish players, I hope you will have fun and will try to survive in Freedom City!  If you find any language errors and want to let us know, please use this thread: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/951430/discussions/0/3376032962080764008/

You can also meet us in Discord:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36253678/39e38a25d692d0b2acc5d73aeccccadae40d64d7.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36253678/7a043625bed512eb39aa8434509dc1db43e7908e.png

First of all, the bad news. I got rheumatism in both wrists (I had played too many Gothic 2 mods ;)) and could only work extremely little the last months. This delayed the development of Dead Age: Survivors, but thanks to medication I can now work much better again and things are progressing.

My best friend Steven ... uhm ... Sandro is currently working on the desert maps and they look pretty nice. We will bring some pictures at Easter.

I'm currently working on the dialog and quest scripting for the new faction: The Lost Ones. The story should be a bit more exciting and atmospheric than in Dead age 2. For me, that's always the coolest thing to work on ;-)
In programming Simone and Pedro are still busy with bugfixing our prototype, but after that it will be about the expansion of the new strategy features, because Dead Age Survivors will have a conquest and defense feature of areas.
  
We will tell (and show) you more about Dead Age: Survivors in the future - so make sure to follow the game and add it to your wishlist. This would really help us a lot! 

Have Fun ,
Rayk (Holy Avatar), Sandro, Pedro and Simone!
Silent Dreams Team
